# 🏆 Community Leagues

Looking for a league to race in, or need more drivers for yours? <#1532005211235684362> is the place.

## 📝 What you can post
• **Promote your league**: running a league and want drivers? Post it.
• **Share the leagues you race in**: help other members find a good grid.
• **Looking for a league?** Browse the posts and filter by tag: game, race day, time of day, region, Competitive or Chill.

## ✅ Posting guidelines
One post per league, with:
• **League name**
• **Description**
• **Join link** (Discord, website, etc.)
Add the tags that fit, keep posts F1-related, clear and up to date, and use replies for questions about a league.

## 🔓 How to see the channel
Community Leagues is only visible with the <@&1556952638413742180> role. React with 🏆 below to get it and the channel shows up right away. Remove your reaction to drop the role again. You can also pick **League racer** in Channels & Roles.

Good luck and race clean! 🏎️💨

# 🎬 New highlight video!

**Even My PC Crashed in This F1 25 Open Lobby Stream**

Seven open lobby races: a fight for P2 at Spa, three wide into Tamburello right before my PC gave up, the wildest Texas turn 1 ever and a Jeddah race where I still don't know how I ended up P2.

Are you in it? 👀
